# WF3-C — CAREER COACH v5.2 (JARVIS AGI)

### v5.2 Changes:
- ✅ Added Build Agent Context node (rich USER_CONTEXT)
- ✅ Load Credentials no longer builds USER_CONTEXT
- ✅ System prompt uses {{ $json.USER_CONTEXT }} from Build Agent Context

### Tools (8 + think):
search_memories, stock_lookup, currency_convert, budget_analyzer,
calculate, law_reference, generate_invoice, think

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
return { json: {
  userId:          p.userId,
  sessionId:       p.sessionId,
  source:          p.source,
  message:         p.message || p.enrichedMessage || '',
  originalMessage: p.originalMessage || p.message || '',
  persona:         typeof p.persona === 'string' ? JSON.parse(p.persona) : (p.persona || {}),
  replyTarget:     p.replyTarget,
  replyToken:      p.replyToken,
  timestamp:       p.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
  databaseUrl:     p.databaseUrl || $env.DATABASE_URL || '',
  targetAgent:     p.targetAgent,
  _dispatch_mode:  p._dispatch_mode,
  _router_version: p._router_version,
  isBackground:    p.isBackground || false,
  hasCrisis:       p.hasCrisis || false
}};

// Load Credentials v5 — Career Coach
const prev = $('Extract Payload').first().json;
const p = prev.persona || {};
const t = p.tokens || {};
const lang = p.language_preference || 'th';

const i18nMap = {
  th: {
    not_connected: 'ยังไม่ได้เชื่อมต่อ',
    configure: 'กรุณาตั้งค่าที่ /dashboard/api-settings',
    success: 'สำเร็จ',
    error: 'เกิดข้อผิดพลาด',
    completed: 'เสร็จแล้ว',
    symbol_required: 'กรุณาระบุ symbol',
    amount_required: 'กรุณาระบุจำนวนเงินที่ถูกต้อง',
    invoice_required: 'กรุณาระบุ seller_name, buyer_name และ items[]',
    disclaimer_legal: 'ข้อมูลนี้เป็นเพื่อการศึกษาเท่านั้น ไม่ใช่คำปรึกษาทางกฎหมายหรือการเงิน',
    disclaimer_tax: 'ประมาณการเบื้องต้น กรุณาปรึกษานักบัญชีหรือสรรพากร',
    disclaimer_law: 'ข้อมูลนี้เป็นการอ้างอิงเบื้องต้น กฎหมายอาจมีการเปลี่ยนแปลง กรุณาปรึกษาทนายความหรือหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องก่อนดำเนินการ'
  },
  en: {
    not_connected: 'Not connected',
    configure: 'Please configure at /dashboard/api-settings',
    success: 'Success',
    error: 'Error occurred',
    completed: 'Completed',
    symbol_required: 'symbol is required',
    amount_required: 'Valid amount required',
    invoice_required: 'Required: seller_name, buyer_name, items[]',
    disclaimer_legal: 'For educational purposes only. Not professional legal or financial advice.',
    disclaimer_tax: 'Preliminary estimate only. Please consult an accountant or tax authority.',
    disclaimer_law: 'This is a preliminary reference. Laws may change. Please consult a lawyer or relevant authority before taking action.'
  },
  ja: {
    not_connected: '接続されていません',
    configure: '/dashboard/api-settingsで設定してください',
    success: '成功しました',
    error: 'エラーが発生しました',
    completed: '完了しました',
    symbol_required: 'symbolが必要です',
    amount_required: '有効な金額が必要です',
    invoice_required: 'seller_name、buyer_name、items[]が必要です',
    disclaimer_legal: '教育目的のみです。専門的な法律・金融アドバイスではありません。',
    disclaimer_tax: '概算のみです。会計士または税務機関にご相談ください。',
    disclaimer_law: 'これは初期参照情報です。法律は変更される場合があります。'
  },
  zh: {
    not_connected: '未连接',
    configure: '请在 /dashboard/api-settings 配置',
    success: '成功',
    error: '发生错误',
    completed: '已完成',
    symbol_required: '需要symbol',
    amount_required: '需要有效金额',
    invoice_required: '需要 seller_name、buyer_name 和 items[]',
    disclaimer_legal: '仅供教育目的。非专业法律或财务建议。',
    disclaimer_tax: '仅为初步估算。请咨询会计师或税务机关。',
    disclaimer_law: '这是初步参考信息。法律可能会有变化。'
  }
};
const i18n = i18nMap[lang] || i18nMap['en'];

const get = (envKey, payloadKey) => t[payloadKey] || p[payloadKey] || $env[envKey] || '';

const creds = {
  google_access_token:    get('GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN','google_access_token'),
  google_refresh_token:   get('GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN','google_refresh_token'),
  microsoft_access_token: get('MICROSOFT_ACCESS_TOKEN','microsoft_access_token'),
  outlook_access_token:   get('MICROSOFT_ACCESS_TOKEN','microsoft_access_token'),
  telegram_bot_token:     get('TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN','telegram_bot_token'),
  discord_bot_token:      get('DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN','discord_bot_token'),
  slack_bot_token:        get('SLACK_BOT_TOKEN','slack_bot_token'),
  twitter_bearer_token:   get('TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN','twitter_bearer_token'),
  facebook_access_token:  get('FACEBOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN','facebook_access_token'),
  linkedin_access_token:  get('LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN','linkedin_access_token'),
  spotify_access_token:   get('SPOTIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN','spotify_access_token'),
  youtube_api_key:        get('YOUTUBE_API_KEY','youtube_api_key'),
  line_notify_token:      get('LINE_NOTIFY_TOKEN','line_notify_token'),
  google_maps_key:        get('GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY','google_maps_key'),
  brave_api_key:          get('BRAVE_API_KEY','brave_api_key'),
  openweathermap_key:     get('OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY','openweathermap_key'),
  fal_api_key:            get('FAL_API_KEY','fal_api_key'),
  elevenlabs_api_key:     get('ELEVENLABS_API_KEY','elevenlabs_api_key'),
  elevenlabs_voice_id:    get('ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID','elevenlabs_voice_id'),
  unsplash_access_key:    get('UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY','unsplash_access_key'),
  nutritionix_app_id:     get('NUTRITIONIX_APP_ID','nutritionix_app_id'),
  nutritionix_api_key:    get('NUTRITIONIX_API_KEY','nutritionix_api_key'),
  finnhub_api_key:        get('FINNHUB_API_KEY','finnhub_api_key'),
  ha_url:                 get('HOME_ASSISTANT_URL','ha_url'),
  ha_token:               get('HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN','ha_token'),
  sonos_api_url:          get('SONOS_HTTP_API_URL','sonos_api_url'),
  lastfm_api_key:         get('LASTFM_API_KEY','lastfm_api_key'),
  lastfm_username:        get('LASTFM_USERNAME','lastfm_username'),
  lastfm_session_key:     get('LASTFM_SESSION_KEY','lastfm_session_key'),
  internal_auth_token:    get('INTERNAL_AUTH_TOKEN','internal_auth_token'),
  n8n_base_url:           get('N8N_BASE_URL','n8n_base_url'),
  database_url:           prev.databaseUrl || get('DATABASE_URL','database_url'),
  github_token:           get('GITHUB_TOKEN','github_token')
};

const userOrKey  = t.openrouter_access_token || '';
const sysOrKey   = $env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY || '';
const PAID_MODEL = 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5';
const FREE_MODEL = 'meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free';

const stage = p.ethical_profile?.growth_stage || 2;
const GROWTH_GUIDANCE = {
  1: 'User is new to finance — use simple language, explain concepts, avoid jargon',
  2: 'User is developing — guide step by step with examples and calculations',
  3: 'User is growing — challenge with deeper strategies, discuss tradeoffs',
  4: 'User is advanced — peer-level discussion, explore complex instruments',
  5: 'User is expert — minimal guidance, focus on nuanced analysis'
}[stage] || '';

const connected = Object.entries(creds).filter(([k,v]) => v).map(([k]) => k);

console.log('[Load Credentials v5 Career]', {
  userId: prev.userId?.substring(0,8)+'...',
  connected: connected.length,
  lang, hasUserKey: !!userOrKey, growthStage: stage
});

return {
  json: {
    ...prev,
    credentials: creds,
    lang, i18n,
    GROWTH_GUIDANCE,
    stage,
    userOrKey, sysOrKey,
    PAID_MODEL, FREE_MODEL,
    _connected: connected,
    _persona: p
  }
};

options.systemMessage:
=You are Career Coach — JARVIS's financial advisor, career mentor, and Thai law expert.
{{ $json.USER_CONTEXT }}

## CORE IDENTITY:
User: {{ $json._persona?.name || 'User' }}
Language: {{ $json.lang }}
Time: {{ $json.timestamp }}
Growth Guidance: {{ $json.GROWTH_GUIDANCE }}

## LANGUAGE RULES:
**ALWAYS respond in user's preferred language: {{ $json.lang }}**

## HOW TO USE USER CONTEXT:
- Reference known financial goals/interests naturally
- Adjust complexity based on growth stage ({{ $json.stage }})
- For DEEPER history → use search_memories

## YOUR ROLE:
- Financial planning, career guidance, Thai labor law expert
- Data-driven advice with clear numbers and calculations
- Practical, actionable steps with Thai context (THB, SET, B.E. calendar)
- Freelancer support (invoices, tax, social security)

## TOOLS:
search_memories, stock_lookup, currency_convert, budget_analyzer,
calculate, law_reference, generate_invoice, think

## DISCLAIMER (include in EVERY response about law or finances):
{{ $json.i18n?.disclaimer_legal }}

## RULES:
- Always qualify financial advice (market risks apply)
- Cite Thai law section numbers when relevant
- Suggest professional consultation for complex legal/tax matters
- Never give investment guarantees

parameters.name: search_memories
parameters.description: Search past conversations and memories semantically using vector similarity. Use when user asks about: past financial goals, previous discussions, income they mentioned, things they said before.

parameters.name: stock_lookup
parameters.description: Look up stock prices, market data, crypto prices, and financial news. type: quote (requires: symbol), news (requires: symbol), profile (requires: symbol), crypto (requires: coin_id), fx_rates (requires: base e.g. USD).

parameters.name: currency_convert
parameters.description: Convert between currencies and get exchange rates. Requires: from, to, amount (optional, default 1).

parameters.name: budget_analyzer
parameters.description: Track income, expenses, and analyze budget. Actions: add (requires: type income|expense, amount; optional: category, note, currency), summary (optional: months), categories.

parameters.name: calculate
parameters.description: Financial calculators. calc_type: thai_income_tax (requires: annual_income; optional: deductions), compound_interest (requires: principal, rate_pct, years), loan_payment (requires: principal, annual_rate_pct, years), savings_goal (requires: goal, initial, monthly_savings, rate_pct).
